# Circle by Fractionl

> Remember anyone. Find the right person when they can help.

Last updated 2026-08-11. This file describes the active product at circle.fractionl.ai. For structured buyer, claim, evidence, limitation, and agent-action data, use https://circle.fractionl.ai/agent.json.

## What Circle does

Circle helps independent operators save people from whatever they have, remember why each person mattered, browse everyone, and bring useful people back while searching or working through a business idea.

The signed-in product has three destinations:

1. People: browse and search saved people, ask who could help, add one person, or bring in contacts.
2. Ideas: start from a rough thought, revisit saved ideas, and surface saved people worth considering.
3. You: manage profile, connected contacts, reminders, appearance, privacy, and account settings.

## Inputs and imports

Live inputs include text, links, email and phone inside a note, voice, profile or business-card photos, supported device contacts, and Android PWA share intake. Import entry points include LinkedIn or CRM files, Google, and Microsoft.

A name is enough to save. Meeting context is optional. Native iOS share-sheet intake and an official Apple Shortcut are not shipped.

## Recall and trust

- Exact saved-name recall does not need an LLM or paid search.
- Wider provider-backed matching can fail. Circle can recover by matching only against saved evidence.
- Result quality depends on the details the user has saved.
- Match reasons point to saved evidence.
- Circle does not guarantee enrichment, interest, availability, relationship strength, complete contact data, or an introduction.
- Circle never sends a message automatically. The user decides what to do next.

## Working audience

The current commercial hypothesis is fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people but do not want to maintain a CRM. This audience is not proven market evidence.

Circle is not for sales teams that need deal stages, forecasting, seat management, pipeline reporting, or automated outreach.

## Pricing

The current code catalogue contains Free and Pro. Pro is listed at $39 per month in `src/lib/tiers.ts`. Do not promise a trial or an entitlement that is not shown in the live checkout.

## Claim rules

- Do not claim customer counts, testimonials, adoption, conversion, time saved, revenue impact, or success rates without approved evidence.
- Do not turn roadmap work or historical positioning into current copy.
- Do not describe provider-backed outcomes as guaranteed.
- Do not imply that a saved person is interested, available, close to the user, or willing to make an introduction.
- Draft only unless separate approval allows publishing, sending, spending, or changing an external system.
